card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space or small token right before a dose number such as 250 mg, 500 mg or 1 g, in antibiotic dosing text. It also fires on the number itself or the middle of erythromycin right after such a dose.

modes.description: Partway through the drug name right after the dose.
